description.en: Kunpeng-Skill is a powerful multimodal distillation toolkit that transforms high-value insights from repositories, websites, UIs, videos, images, and documents into reusable methodologies, model-agnostic regeneration specifications, and more.
description.zh: 多模态蒸馏工具，将仓库、网站、UI、视频等转化为可复用的方法论和再生规范。

audience.zh: 知识工作者、AI 研究者

usecases.zh: 从多模态内容中提取可复用的方法论和规范
usecases.en: Extract reusable methodologies and specs from multimodal content
